name: Home dumbbell week
notes: Dumbbell strength three times and Sunday body stats. Add Daily cardio and Full-body stretch if you want those on the same week.

exercises.name: Dumbbell deadlift
exercises.notes: Use the dumbbells you actually lift; 12kg is only a starting placeholder.
exercises.instructions: Hinge, bar-path close, stand tall without shrugging.

exercises.name: Dumbbell bent-over row
exercises.notes: Use the dumbbells you actually lift; 12kg is only a starting placeholder.
exercises.instructions: Torso still. Pull elbows toward the hips.

exercises.name: Dumbbell standing shoulder press
exercises.notes: Use the dumbbells you actually lift; 12kg is only a starting placeholder.
exercises.instructions: Brace, press up, do not over-arch the lower back.

exercises.name: Dumbbell lateral raise
exercises.notes: Use the dumbbells you actually lift; 12kg is only a starting placeholder.
exercises.instructions: Soft elbows, raise to just below shoulder height.

exercises.name: Dumbbell floor press
exercises.notes: Use the dumbbells you actually lift; 12kg is only a starting placeholder.
exercises.instructions: Upper arms touch the floor, then press. Keep ribs down.

exercises.name: Dumbbell floor fly
exercises.notes: Use the dumbbells you actually lift; 12kg is only a starting placeholder.
exercises.instructions: Wide arc, slight elbow bend. Stop when upper arms reach the floor.

exercises.name: Dumbbell curl
exercises.notes: Use the dumbbells you actually lift; 12kg is only a starting placeholder.
exercises.instructions: Elbows by the ribs. Lower under control.

exercises.name: Dumbbell standing tricep extension
exercises.notes: Use the dumbbells you actually lift; 12kg is only a starting placeholder.
exercises.instructions: Elbows high and still. Lower behind the head, then extend.

exercises.name: Dumbbell goblet squat
exercises.notes: Use the dumbbells you actually lift; 12kg is only a starting placeholder.
exercises.instructions: Hold the bell at the chest. Sit between the hips.

exercises.name: Dumbbell lunge
exercises.notes: Use the dumbbells you actually lift; 12kg is only a starting placeholder.
exercises.instructions: Long step, back knee close to the floor, torso tall.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
exercises.notes: Use the dumbbells you actually lift; 12kg is only a starting placeholder.
exercises.instructions: Soft knees, hinge, dumbbells close to the legs.

exercises.name: Lying leg raise
exercises.instructions: Lower the legs without the lower back peeling up. Alternate with the plank.
exercises.notes: Superset with front plank. No rest until both sets are done, then rest 2 minutes.

exercises.name: Front plank
exercises.instructions: Ribs down, glutes on. Alternate with lying leg raises, then rest 2 minutes.

activities.name: Body stats
activities.instructions: Log any stats you want to track. Store photos as a link so the browser does not keep the image file.
